## What this assignment will cover

- Reason about public and private access modifiers.
- Explain when C++ calls constructors and destructors and why that matters.
- Define a class and implement it across .h and .cpp files.
- Implement constructors, destructors, and general methods.
- Instantiate objects statically.

## Course skills

Primary practice for skills **B1, B2, B3, B5**. See
[Skills & Check-Ins](../checkins.html) for what each one means and when it is assessed.

## Getting the code

You will accept the assignment through Classroom 50, which creates your own private
repository from the starter code. The accept link appears here when the assignment
is published.

## Submitting

Commit and push to `main`. Every push is graded automatically — check the **Actions**
tab of your repository for the run and **Releases** for your score. Your most recent
submission before the deadline is the one that counts.
